description: The open GitHub pull requests that need you, as a folder at the top of the sidebar: review requests, then your own PRs with changes requested, failing checks or conflicts, and the ones ready to merge. Click a PR to start a thread with its title, status, branch and description as context, in the project whose remote is that repository. Snooze a PR until it changes, and pick sources, drafts and organizations. Reads GitHub through the gh CLI on the bb server; Thread Tree draws the folder in its own list when installed.
